description: This file provides mock implementations and utility functions for testing provider models in a machine learning or AI framework. It includes functions to find, clone, and normalize models and transports, as well as to build dynamic models based on provider capabilities. It also exports a function to create a mock runtime environment for testing different providers.

methods.name: findTemplate
methods.description: Finds a template model from the model registry based on provider and template IDs.

methods.name: cloneTemplate
methods.description: Creates a clone of a template model with modifications, used for customizing models.

methods.name: normalizeDynamicModel
methods.description: Normalizes a dynamic model configuration, especially for openai-codex provider.

methods.name: normalizeTransport
methods.description: Normalizes transport configuration based on provider and context, handling special cases for known APIs.

methods.name: buildDynamicModel
methods.description: Builds a dynamic model object based on provider, model ID, and capabilities, supporting multiple providers.

methods.name: createProviderRuntimeTestMock
methods.description: Creates a mock runtime environment for testing provider models, including functions to resolve, normalize, and run models.
